A '''sea monster''' that inhabited the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] was long [[Death/Legends|dead]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The creature's preserved remains were discovered around [[3643 BBY]], and biological samples were taken from its corpse before it decayed completely.<ref name="In Its Bones" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sea monster, whose physical appearance was never described, was first mentioned in the Bioanalysis crewskill mission "In Its Bones" in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="In Its Bones" />
